content: The REINFORCE algorithm BIBREF15 has been shown to improve encoder-decoder text-rewriting systems by allowing to directly optimize a non-differentiable objective BIBREF29 , BIBREF31 , BIBREF7 or to inject task-specific constraints BIBREF32 , BIBREF66 . However, we are not aware of any attempts to use reinforcement learning for training a sentence ranker in the context of extractive summarization.
